stories.title: Ferry fire in the Philippines leaves 5 dead and 86 missing
stories.summary: A fire broke out on a passenger ferry near Coron in Palawan, killing at least five people with dozens still unaccounted for, the coast guard said. Rescuers are searching for survivors.

stories.title: Trump promises every American adult $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
stories.summary: President Donald Trump said he would hand every adult American a $5,000 'Trump dividend' if the GOP holds both chambers in November. He gave no details on cost or funding.

stories.title: Apple unveils $1,999 foldable iPhone Duo
stories.summary: Apple unveiled a foldable iPhone Duo priced at $1,999, pushing its lineup further upmarket. The foldable is notable for using an AI-designed hinge and a reference-image system to certify photos aren't AI-generated.

stories.title: China's AI chipmakers raise prices 20-50% on HBM shortage
stories.summary: Huawei, Cambricon, MetaX and Iluvatar CoreX hiked prices on current and next-gen AI accelerators by up to 50% as the high-bandwidth memory shortage bites. The squeeze complicates Beijing's drive to build Nvidia alternatives.

stories.title: AI startup Listen Labs scraps $1.5B round for Salesforce talks
stories.summary: AI research startup Listen Labs walked away from a $1.5 billion funding round in favor of acquisition talks with Salesforce, according to TechCrunch. The move underscores how AI startups are increasingly courting strategic buyers.

stories.title: Browns' Deshaun Watson set for first start since 2024 season
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson is set to make his first regular-season start since October 2024 in Sunday's season opener at Jacksonville. He acknowledged the weight of the opportunity as he prepares to face a Jaguars team he is 7-0 against career-wise.

stories.title: Browns' offense looks to establish explosive passing attack against Jaguars
stories.summary: Ahead of Sunday's opener in Jacksonville, Cleveland is leaning on Deshaun Watson and the wideout room to unlock its deep passing game. Watson showed a downfield spark during training camp that the staff wants to carry into Week 1.

stories.title: Madring's unforgiving layout raises red-flag fears for F1 debut
stories.summary: Drivers expect the brand-new Madring circuit in Madrid, hosting this weekend's Spanish GP, to be hard on cars with high-speed spots prone to big crashes. Its tight, aggressive layout has already triggered safety concerns ahead of the track's F1 debut.

stories.title: Who is Patrick Havas, alleged attacker at Amy Acton campaign event
stories.summary: Patrick Havas is accused of attacking someone at an event for Ohio Democratic Senate candidate Amy Acton. The incident has drawn attention as the closely watched Senate race heads toward November.

stories.title: Columbus man reverses plea in deadly road-rage shooting
stories.summary: A Columbus man who had pled guilty in a deadly road-rage shooting has retained new counsel and reversed his plea. The case will move forward in court after the change.

stories.title: List: Central Ohio events marking 9/11 anniversary
stories.summary: Central Ohio communities are hosting memorial ceremonies for the 25th anniversary of 9/11, including a flag-planting at the Ohio Statehouse. NBC4 rounded up the remembrances scheduled across the region.

stories.title: List: Columbus-area top home sales for August
stories.summary: NBC4 compiled the top Columbus-area home sales from August, including several seven-figure transactions. The list tracks the region's high end of the housing market.
